culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Eiichiro Kondo. Conan investigates the scene and realizes that it was a murder made to look like an accident. He explains that Kondo was the one who they saw jump off the observation deck and reveals that when Kondo jumped, he landed on a tree below the cliff where he then proceeded to push the unconscious Hirai off the tree. As evidence, Conan reveals that the tree had a mejiro's nest and that spider's web, a collectible that mejiro birds use to build their nests, was found on Hirai. summary.en: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are on a hiking trip in Nishitama. When they reach the Mt. Kotengu observation deck, they witness a man jump off the edge to his death. The body was found at the bottom of the hill and is identified to be Takaya Hirai.
